Every claimed speculative result is re-executed normally by `HostToolRouter(verify_claims=True)` and the two result digests are compared, so the model is held fixed and a mismatch can only come from scheduling. A verifier error is **not** evidence of losslessness: S6 fails closed unless every claim is verified, and the rule-of-three bound is taken over verified claims only.
